response: Saved Views is available today, giving you a faster way to return to the exact filters, sorting, and grouping you rely on most. Instead of rebuilding a list every time, save it once and jump back in with a single click. Saved Views is included in all paid plans, so every team on a paid subscription can start using it right away. Each user can save up to 50 views, covering personal workflows, client work, and everything in between. Need a teammate to see the same setup? Views can be shared with a team, so everyone works from the same list without recreating filters from scratch. Whether you're tracking overdue tasks, sprint boards, or weekly priorities, Saved Views keeps your most important lists one click away. Give it a try on your next project, and let us know what you think. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
